text:
jen: Heads-up — hotfix PR #8420 is blocking the cutover. We need two approvals before the 11:30 PST cutoff or we switch to the rollback path. Can people ping owners? :alarm_clock:
omar: On it, starting review now. Any targeted smoke checks you want me to run?
jen: Main risk is the DB migration toggle (feature_flag -> true). Smoke: run the migration script, check runner logs, and do a quick `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated = FALSE;`
ci-bot: CI status: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration tests failing (flaky-redis-test). Retrying in 30s.
kevin: I can be a second signoff if smoke passes. Can someone paste the exact migration command?
jen: Command: ```./scripts/run_migration --id=hotfix-8420 --dry-run=false``` Also look at `tail -n 200 /var/log/migration-runner.log` for errors.
lee: Running smoke now. DB check shows 0 rows left to migrate, logs show two INFO lines, no ERRORs.
omar: Reviewed the diff — only minor doc nits, behavior looks correct. Approving now. :thumbsup:
omar: Approve — LGTM.
kevin: Eyeballs done. Approving now. Approve — LGTM. :white_check_mark:
jen: Great, that's two approvals. I'll merge at 11:12 and start the rollout. Tagging release and watching metrics.
sara: Quick Q: if errors spike, do we auto-pause and roll back, or manual? Confirm policy.
jen: Policy: 10% initial canary, pause threshold = 2% error rate, auto-rollback after 5m if not recovered. I'll monitor and escalate if needed.
ci-bot: merge: PR #8420 merged by jen at 11:12:34 PST.
jen: Deploy kicked off. Will post updates here.
lee: Seeing a small latency blip but still within SLO. Dash link: http://go/ops/dash#8420
omar: Looks stable on my side. Closing out unless anything else pops. :tada:
